description.value: A family-run ranch lodge with four guest suites situated 20 minutes above Kelowna at the edge of Myra-Bellevue Provincial Park, directly adjacent to the legendary Kettle Valley Railway trestles. The Kurz family lives on-site alongside goats, horses, chickens, and dogs, creating a working-ranch atmosphere with private decks and valley views. No televisions (except one suite), campfires, and morning animals make it a genuinely unhurried base for exploring the Myra Canyon trestle route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and describes a family-run ranch/lodge near the Kettle Valley Railway trestles at Myra Canyon, with four guest suites. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, e-bike charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website refers to the property consistently as 'the Ranch' rather than 'Myra Canyon Lodge' as listed in OSM. The trestles are mentioned as a nearby activity, confirming awareness of the cycling route, but no cycling infrastructure is documented.
concerns: OSM lists the business as 'Myra Canyon Lodge' but the website refers to the property exclusively as 'the Ranch' with no use of that name — possible name mismatch or informal branding.
No phone number in OSM or on the website content retrieved.
Address city/postal code absent from OSM record; full address unconfirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Ideal location for KVR/Myra Canyon trestle cyclists, but the website makes no mention of secure bike storage (a required criterion) or any cycling-specific amenities; direct outreach is needed to confirm whether the property can meet WWC minimum requirements.
